race.description: Five Star Day Spa 3YO Mdn Plate
race.comment: THE THORNCASTER (5) good type resuming after running some respectable races in his first campaign. Back with the two trials and the booking of Zac Lloyd is a good guide to his chances. Right in this. MOVIE STAR (9) well bred Maurice filly who stalked the good tempo on debut with a close up third over 1200m at this track. Doesn't have to improve much to get off the mark. ETERLOU (1) Microphone gelding from Chamrousse on debut for the Pride stable. Has shown a lot more purpose in his last two trials and can take a hand in the finish from the inside gate. ZYNARO (7) comes right into the mix first-up after some key scratchings.
